items.description: Radar model, serial number, firmware, band, PRF, bandwidth, pulse count and range-gate count are frozen in a versioned radar_config_id.
The radar exports raw complex H and V IQ rather than power-only products.
H and V are acquired simultaneously or with a documented coherent timing relationship.
Frame, beam, scan and file relationships are documented and hardware_sequence is retained.
A continuous raw-IQ bench capture completes without process failure.
Sustained write throughput exceeds the measured raw stream rate with at least 50 percent headroom.
Radar host, video device and truth logger share UTC or have a documented clock-offset mapping.
Every radar sample or frame carries an acquisition timestamp and monotonic hardware sequence.
Video preserves frame timing and can be mapped to UTC.
At least five visible synchronization events are recorded by radar/truth logging and video.
Absolute radar-video synchronization error P95 is within the preregistered pilot limit.
Maximum absolute radar-video synchronization error is within the preregistered pilot limit.
H/V cable and software channel mapping is independently verified.
Complex dtype, finite values, I/Q variability and expected array shapes pass inspection.
A fixed reference target and an empty-scene capture are retained under the same radar configuration.
Reference-target H/V relative-amplitude repeatability standard deviation passes the pilot limit.
Reference-target H/V relative-phase circular standard deviation passes the pilot limit.
Saturated complex samples remain below the pilot quality limit in both channels.
Calibration files, method and validity interval are frozen under calibration_id.
Operator, truth recorder, target operator, data/safety role and stop authority are assigned.
The full field chain records a continuous target-free background segment.
Dropped-frame fraction during the dry run stays below the pilot limit.
No unplanned clock reset occurs during the dry run.
The dry-run manifest passes the capture profile with referenced files checked.
The dry-run manifest passes the causal profile with verified sequence and both channels valid.
A clean-machine replay reads IQ, reconstructs RD output and aligns video/truth without manual path repair.
Before leaving the site, raw data and metadata exist on at least two independent storage devices with hashes.
Pure-background scenario has at least three independently restarted sessions.
Unloaded-balloon scenario has at least three independently restarted sessions.
Same-balloon loaded-stable scenario has at least three independently restarted sessions.
Loaded swing/natural-motion scenario has at least three independently restarted sessions.
Every accepted pilot session contains at least two minutes of continuous usable observation.
Every target session has full video coverage and state start/end labels rather than one file-level state label.
Target and background controls exist under the same date, site, radar configuration and calibration.
The complete pilot manifest passes the causal contract; it is not promoted to locked_test.
Two physical copies, manifest, configuration, calibration, truth files and SHA256 inventory are complete.
A pilot quality report records accepted/rejected sessions, synchronization error, channel quality, missing data and next decision.
No unresolved safety incident occurred during the pilot.
